_notes: 6-10 sentences, 20-40 s (aim 25-35). FOLLOW BRAND.md §0: sentence 1 = a SURPRISE hook with a number; max 5 numbers said, round, no decimals or equations; <=14 words a sentence; a re-hook every 5-8 s ('Sounds amazing, right?', 'But here's the catch.'). Last sentence = the loop line, ending on a hand-over (':' ',' or '…') that runs into sentence 1. No spoken calls to action. Palette rotates automatically; add "theme" to override. Tell it as the DOPAMINE LOOP (BRAND.md §0c): risk (who could lose what, by when) in the first 3 s; at least two question -> twist loops joined by a rehook; 'steps' labels every sentence (risk / question / twist / rehook / answer / context / loop).
